description: Display-ready transform of analysis.build_tag_summary's stored output, truncated to the top_n most populous tags.
signature: def build_tag_summary_table(tag_summary: pd.DataFrame, *, top_n: int = 100) -> pd.DataFrame
docstring:
Build the display-ready tag summary table.

Args:
    tag_summary: analysis_results['tag_summary'] deserialized back into a DataFrame.
    top_n: Maximum rows to return, selected by n_games descending (most-represented tags first) -- a display convenience since a run's full tag vocabulary can be large.

Returns:
    A DataFrame limited to top_n rows sorted by n_games descending, with rounded/human-readable columns as in build_opportunity_matrix_view.
postconditions: Result has at most top_n rows
Result is sorted by n_games descending

edge_cases.input: tag_summary has fewer than top_n rows
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns all of them, without padding, per the same 'no padding when the pool is smaller' convention used by select_case_studies
returns an empty DataFrame with the expected columns

unit_tests.name: test_returns_top_n_by_game_count
unit_tests.description: top_n=5 on a fixture with 20 tags returns exactly the 5 most-represented tags.

unit_tests.name: test_fewer_rows_than_top_n_returns_all
unit_tests.description: top_n=100 on a fixture with 10 tags returns all 10, no padding.
